result.journal: International Journal of Emerging Technologies in Learning (iJET)
result.keywords: This study presents a fictional adaptive learning approach for English language instruction in higher education that combines Moodle-based delivery with proficiency-level personalization. Learners complete a diagnostic pre-test and are grouped into elementary, intermediate, and advanced levels, after which the system recommends tailored activities, feedback, and assessments. A pilot implementation with mixed-ability students examines motivating and demotivating factors in online learning, including pedagogy, interface usability, and institutional support. Results indicate improved engagement across all levels, with the strongest gains observed among intermediate and advanced learners and a reduction in frustration among elementary learners.
result.title: Adaptive Moodle-Based English Learning with Proficiency-Level Personalization
